# Air France Scraper

<!-- This README is generated by .github/scripts/docs.py from the scraper code, its results/ folder and .github/scrapers.json: change those and run the script instead of editing it. -->

[![tests](https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers/raw/ci-status/badges/airfrance-scraper.svg)](https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers/blob/ci-status/status/airfrance-scraper.md)

Example scraper that collects round-trip flight offers from airfrance.fr, written in Python with the [Scrapfly](https://scrapfly.io/) web scraping API. Part of [scrapfly-scrapers](../README.md).

- **Guide:** [How to Scrape Air France Flights with Python (2026)](https://scrapfly.io/blog/posts/how-to-scrape-air-france-flights)
- **Code:** [`airfrance.py`](airfrance.py) · **Example run:** [`run.py`](run.py) · **Tests:** [`test.py`](test.py)
- **Sample output:** [Roundtrip](results/roundtrip.json)

## What it scrapes

- Air France round-trip search results
- Flight price, airline, departure/arrival times, stops, duration, layovers, and CO2 data
- Plane model, seats available, and promo flags

## Functions

- `scrape_flights(origin, destination, departure_date, return_date, max_retries=3)` → `List[Flight]` (not async): Scrape flight offers from Air France search GraphQL XHR.

## Output

The functions return plain dictionaries and lists. Fields:

- **`Layover`**: `airport`, `duration_minutes?`
- **`Flight`**: `airline`, `flight_number`, `departure_time`, `departure_airport`, `arrival_time`, `arrival_airport`, `arrives_next_days`, `duration_minutes`, `stops`, `layovers`, `price`, `currency`, `cabin_class`, `seats_available?`, `is_promo`, `promo_title?`, `has_special_fare`, `seat_map_eligible`, `plane_model`, `co2_kg`, `airport_change_warning?`

A field marked `?` can be `null`.

## Quick start

Requires Python 3.10+ and [Poetry](https://python-poetry.org/docs/#installation).

```shell
git clone https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers.git
cd scrapfly-scrapers/airfrance-scraper
export SCRAPFLY_KEY="YOUR SCRAPFLY KEY"   # from https://scrapfly.io/dashboard
poetry install --no-root
poetry run python run.py                  # example scrape, saves its output in ./results
poetry run pytest test.py                 # the tests of this scraper
```

Tests: `test_scrape_flights`; run one with `poetry run pytest test.py -k <test>`. `run.py` and the tests scrape the live website, so they use Scrapfly credits.
